queries.sql: SELECT 'before' AS period, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.purchase_order po WHERE po.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-29' AND po.order_date < DATE '2024-03-01') AS DOUBLE) / date_diff('day', DATE '2024-01-29', DATE '2024-03-01') AS value UNION ALL SELECT 'after' AS period, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.purchase_order po WHERE po.order_date >= DATE '2024-04-22' AND po.order_date < DATE '2024-07-01') AS DOUBLE) / date_diff('day', DATE '2024-04-22', DATE '2024-07-01') AS value

SELECT 'before' AS period, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.purchase_order po WHERE po.supplier_id = 'SUP-001' AND CAST(po.is_late AS BOOLEAN) AND po.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-29' AND po.order_date < DATE '2024-03-01') AS DOUBLE) / date_diff('day', DATE '2024-01-29', DATE '2024-03-01') AS value UNION ALL SELECT 'after' AS period, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.purchase_order po WHERE po.supplier_id = 'SUP-001' AND CAST(po.is_late AS BOOLEAN) AND po.order_date >= DATE '2024-04-22' AND po.order_date < DATE '2024-07-01') AS DOUBLE) / date_diff('day', DATE '2024-04-22', DATE '2024-07-01') AS value

SELECT 'before' AS period, (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN s.value <= 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FROM main.stock_snapshot s JOIN main.product p ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE p.supplier_id = 'SUP-001' AND s.date >= DATE '2024-01-29' AND s.date < DATE '2024-03-01') AS value UNION ALL SELECT 'after' AS period, (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN s.value <= 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FROM main.stock_snapshot s JOIN main.product p ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE p.supplier_id = 'SUP-001' AND s.date >= DATE '2024-04-22' AND s.date < DATE '2024-07-01') AS value
